item.description: Missing SwitchValue class implementation. Tests expect this class to exist for switch value operations but it's missing from the DSL implementation.
item.contract: Implement the SwitchValue class that supports switch value operations with pattern matching capabilities. The class should support creation with a value and a list of (patterns, value) pairs, and should be compatible with the existing AST infrastructure.

item.description: Missing FrozenError exception class. Tests expect this exception to be raised when trying to modify frozen memory, but it's not implemented.
item.contract: Implement the FrozenError exception class in the memory module. This should be a subclass of Exception that can be raised when attempting to modify a frozen memory.

item.description: Missing ports attribute in Instance class. Tests expect the Instance class to have a 'ports' attribute to properly handle instance port connections.
item.contract: Add a 'ports' attribute to the Instance class that stores port information in the same format as the existing named_ports attribute. This should be accessible for netlist generation and instance handling.

item.description: Missing MemoryData class. Tests expect this class to be available for memory construction and handling but it's not implemented.
item.contract: Implement the MemoryData class that serves as a data structure for memory data representation. This class should be referenced in memory-related tests and support proper memory construction.

item.description: Missing DuplicateElaboratable exception class. Tests expect this exception to be raised when duplicate elaboratables are detected but it's not implemented.
item.contract: Implement the DuplicateElaboratable exception class in the IR module. This should be a subclass of Exception that gets raised when the same elaboratable is included multiple times in the hierarchy.
